checks.orientation: Head and shoulders forward and aligned; no sideways neck twist.
checks.gaze: Chin gently lowered, both eyes directed toward visible coffee cup.
checks.hands: Natural right-hand handle grip, elbow supported by café counter, free hand relaxed near waist. Free hand does not rest on counter as requested, but anatomy and relaxed position are acceptable.
checks.identity: Same curls, stubble, skin texture, olive overshirt and ivory tee.
checks.mood: Soft closed-mouth expression and ordinary daylight, no camera eye contact.

limits: Subjective still review; separately review motion, hand stability and gaze.
